definitions.explanation: The broader or more inclusive meaning of a word or concept. Used when distinguishing between a wider and narrower interpretation of a term.

examples.japanese: {広義|こうぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧」⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦{様式|ようしき}→様式：05455_youshiki⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれる→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: "Culture" in the broad sense also includes lifestyle.

examples.japanese: {広義|こうぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{解釈|かいしゃく}すれば→解釈する：26837_kaishakusuru⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{適用|てきよう}される→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧。
examples.english: If interpreted broadly, this law applies.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{広義|こうぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{狭義|きょうぎ}→狭義：13535_kyougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指|さ}す→指す：02056_sasu⟧。
examples.english: In the broad sense "family" includes relatives, but in the narrow sense it means only the people who live in the same house.

notes:
USAGE:
A scholarly and formal word used when defining or clarifying the scope of terms. Frequently paired with its opposite, ⟦{狭義|きょうぎ}→狭義：13535_kyougi⟧ (narrow sense). Common in academic writing, legal texts, and formal explanations.
